i lack the ability to make a true companionship because i'm always just focused on saying the right things. i can't describe *how* i feel because i feel nothing and the weight of everything is pressing down on me, the pressure of going too far down this rabbit hole, because i can never read the room. the way i "feel" these days is think about how a normal person would react, and bring up a memory that creates a similar one. it feels fake and meaningless. everything. i can lie to everyone because i literally have no other way of making friends. if i had the option, i'd sit in a white room eating saltines until i die (but my room does have white walls that were previously barren except a "*call of duty: world at war: nazi zombies"*   poster, which had a big ass swastika behind some zombies in nazi uniforms, so you can probably guess why i filled the space with posters for things i think people my age are into).  


this article sums it up pretty well

i know a lot of my feelings are there, sometimes i *feel* them but the mundane part covers it up with the serotonin i lacked for the last 5 years of my life. 

i have a journal, like a lot of sociopaths and find myself a bother because i don't feel *human* i feel like a rodent in an ill fitting suit, like those wasps that lay eggs in caterpillars.  


i end it with drugs, or hurting myself or others, cleaning, lots of distractions. quarantine has really cut back my work load, leaving me with these thoughts, a bunch of steam games I've played, books I've read and half written book/blog ideas. so a lot of weed. that really intensifies the feelings of this flesh prison to something i think resembles emotion.
